privileged_info_for_vlm: The target Opportunity is 'GlobalMedia - 1000 Licenses'. The target Bug is 'Login page timeout error'. The relationship must be specifically 'Many-to-Many'. Success is defined by the Bug appearing in a subpanel on the Opportunity's detail page after the relationship is created in Studio.
